title: Invited to Hearken: The Lord’s Preface to the Doctrine and Covenants
author: David Golding

footnotes.text: See “Minutes, 1–2 November 1831: Historical Introduction,” josephsmithpapers.org; “Minutes, 1–2 November 1831,” 15, josephsmithpapers.org.
The texts of Genesis, Matthew, 1 Nephi, and Moses do not present the Lord speaking directly to the reader but refer to and quote the Lord in the third person.

Such historical details are provided and explained in several publications, includingThe Joseph Smith Papers,Revelations in Context, andSaints. For a collection of study resources from these and other projects, see “Historical Resources” in the Church History section of the Gospel Library.
